subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Identificar e analisar os efeitos de sentido que fortalecem a persuasão nos textos publicitários, relacionando as estratégias de persuasão e apelo ao consumo com os recursos linguístico-discursivos utilizados, como imagens, tempo verbal, jogos de palavras, figuras de linguagem etc., com vistas a fomentar práticas de consumo conscientes.

components.description_pt: Identificar recursos linguístico-discursivos como imagens, tempo verbal, trocadilhos e figuras de linguagem em textos publicitários
components.description_en: Identify linguistic-discursive resources — such as images, verb tense, wordplay, and figures of speech — used in advertising texts
components.cc_component_description: Identify figures of speech such as euphemism and oxymoron within a text

components.description_pt: Analisar como estratégias de persuasão e apelo ao consumo são construídas através de escolhas linguísticas e visuais específicas
components.description_en: Analyze how persuasion and consumption-appeal strategies are constructed through specific linguistic and visual choices in advertisements
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how specific rhetorical choices strengthen or shape an author's argument

components.description_pt: Avaliar efeitos de significado de estratégias persuasivas em textos publicitários para desenvolver práticas de consumo consciente
components.description_en: Evaluate the meaning effects of persuasive strategies in advertising texts in order to develop conscious consumption practices
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate the impact of specific word choices on the meaning and tone of a narrative

cc_matches.description: Interpret figures of speech (e.g., euphemism, oxymoron) in context and analyze their role in the text.

Multilingual learners will interpret language arts narratives by
* Identifying a theme __or central idea that develops over the course of a text__
* Analyzing how character attributes and actions develop __in relation to events or dialogue__
* __Evaluating impact of specific word choices about meaning and tone__
Determine an author's point of view or purpose in a text and analyze how an author uses rhetoric to advance that point of view or purpose.
